evals.name: basic-types-translation
evals.prompt: Translate the Markdown file dev/evals/test_cases/basic-types.md to a bilingual Markdown file, then validate the formatting using doc-bilingual-translator validation script.
evals.expected_output: A W3C-spacing compliant bilingual Markdown file, preserving code block formatting and translating all headers and paragraphs correctly with dynamic glossary mapping applied.
expectations: Chinese translation is placed directly in the [zh] block of each :::block structure.
Reserved TypeScript keywords (e.g. string, number, boolean) remain untranslated in English.
No Markdown links or image URLs are modified or corrupted.
Correct space is inserted between Chinese characters and Western characters/numbers.

evals.name: conditional-types-translation
evals.prompt: Translate the Markdown file dev/evals/test_cases/conditional-types.md to a bilingual Markdown file, then validate the formatting using doc-bilingual-translator validation script.
evals.expected_output: A W3C-spacing compliant bilingual Markdown file, preserving conditional types code samples and translating technical sections correctly with glossary mapping applied.
expectations: Technical term 'Conditional Types' is translated using the designated glossary if provided.
All code blocks starting with triple backticks remain untouched outside :::block wrappers.
No sentences are omitted in the translated segments.
There are no missing spaces between CJK characters and Latin/numerical characters.
